name: Cranes Software International Limited
about: Cranes Software International Limited provides enterprise statistical analytics and engineering simulation software products and solutions in India and internationally. The company offers AutoSignal, a program that automates the process of analyzing signals; Cubeware Cockpit, Cubeware Team Server, Cubeware Importer, and OLAP databases; eta/VPG, a tool to create finite element models and simulations for mechanical system analyses; eta/Dynaform, a simulation software solution; InventX, a strategic project portfolio management solution; and iCapella, used by public and private sector organizations to measure operational performance and disseminate business intelligence throughout its enterprises to employees, partners, and suppliers. It also provides MEMS, a batch fabricated sensing and actuation systems that integrate the mechanical and electronic components on the same chip at micro and nano scales; NISA, provides finite element analysis programs; PeakFit, a non-linear modeling of statistical and chromatographic data; SYSTAT, scientific software for technical professionals; SigmaPlot, a graphing application; TableCurve 2D, a program for curve-fitting and data modeling for critical research; and TableCurve 3D, a program that combines a surface fitter with the ability to find the ideal equation to describe three-dimensional empirical data. In addition, the company offers IPs and products in data integration and visualization, engineering simulations, graphing, plotting, and designing modules; crane engineering and business analytics services; and hands-on technical training for graduates and working professionals in the fields of mathematical modeling and simulation, and embedded systems design and digital signal processing under the Cranes Varsity name. It also exports its products. Cranes Software International Limited was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
